pages.text: Put unenchanted astral equipment and fuel into a blast furnace. Chestplates return at most2 ingots; other equipment returns at most1. Remaining durability scales the amount, rounded up; depleted items cannot recycle. Use a grindstone first to remove enchantments. Ascension and reinforcement materials are never returned.
$(bold)recycling.enabled$()$(br2)Use /astral help for controls and /astral stats for counters. Restart the world after configuration changes.
